title: Royal Enfield Continental GT 650 Review - Better Than Interceptor | Faisal Khan
description: Here is the most detailed review of the Royal Enfield Continental GT 650, I tell you everything about the design, cluster, features, performance, ride, handling, braking, price and of course give you a verdict on whether you should buy a Royal Enfield Continental GT 650 in India. This Royal Enfield Continental GT 650 road test is a long ride one with a real-world perspective of the twin-cylinder cafe racer from Royal Enfield. asr.full_text: Hi Friends! Log on to my website, fastbeam.com and talk to me on the forums also don't forget to follow me on Instagram Oh my god! The Interceptor 650 is so much fun and I am back at the first Mumbai stall, the Royal Enfield dealership in Worli, Mumbai and I want to ride that motorcycle! The beautiful, GT 650! This is a Chrome edition let's quickly get inside the showroom Says, made like a gun, over here Attention to detail is crazy at royal enfield showrooms as you can see it is a child's dream to come here because there's so many things to play around with look at motorcycles look at merchandise and obviously a lot of history as well as you can see over there so it tells you exactly the evolution of royal enfield and in 2018 it says interceptor 650 twin 648 cc meanwhile 1901 one and a half horsepower royal enfield 211 cc well they have indeed come a long way so now i need to get the keys of the other motorcycle uh do you have the keys dude excuse me do you have the keys i don't think he has the key let's see which other dude can help you with the keys excuse me do you have the keys gt650 bro that comes at an exchange all right here you go here's the interceptor keys here's the gt650 keys thanks anyways so this is the store i already shown you around this corner in the previous video of the interceptor 650 all seat is beautifully contoured over here to give that cafe racer look the taillight doesn't use led actually this bike doesn't use leds at all so these are traditional lights traditional indicators but hey it retains the classic charm or the retro charm now you can see attention to detail over here all infill written on the peg and let me show you a few things around for starters the riding position is obviously more aggressive when compared to the interceptor 650 here it goes does a full swipe up and let's turn on the motorcycle and it rose to life now this instrument cluster is kind of basic analog tachometer analog speedometer telltale lights over here and there's a digital display which shows you the fuel meter odometer and twin trip meters well that's about it a neat thing is how the re badge is placed over here and obviously the riding position is slightly more aggressive when compared to the interceptor but it is still less aggressive when you compare it to the older gt535 so let's quickly rev the motor yeah it kind of revs very nice and smoothly in fact this motorcycle doesn't feel like a royal enfield at all it is such a big leap now you can see this is the placement for the traditional mirrors but this one gets bar ends right now and the only gripe i have with this motorcycle obviously is the fuel lid because it comes in your hand so when you're filling fuel you're going to be holding this like that which isn't cool at this price point it should have got a proper one with the holding mechanism anyways some effort to close it yeah that is closed this is the key of this motorcycle similar to other royal enfield motorcycles and this motorcycle doesn't get a main stand well obviously you can opt for that in an accessory so this is the motorcycle I think we should wear gear and get riding right away all right let's get rolling here we go motorcycle is so smooth and the pegs are rear set when compared to the interceptor and off I go performance is really very nice okay abruptly going into the rev limit which happens to be seven and a half thousand rpm this one inspires more to the rather center set pegs on the interceptor 650. Now I was thinking that I will definitely like the interceptor more and the world actually likes the interceptor more because 80% sales are from the interceptor, 20% are from the Continental GT 650. Now why is it like that? Well simply because Royal Enfield made the previous Continental GT very aggressive. So getting through traffic like this on a motorcycle like a Royal Enfield, surprisingly easy and look my foot is not down at all and I'm able to filter through traffic like this, wow. Now never did I think I'm going to do such things on a Royal Enfield motorcycle but it is so nimble and easy to maneuver and flick, very impressive a motorcycle not it is only slightly leaned in which is not bad at all the other one the previous 535 the previous continental gt was very uncomfortable because it was quite leaned in and that's why most people don't even want to try this motorcycle but trust me try this and you will be pleasantly surprised it is so brilliant okay it's distraction g e g le 43 am g over there so as you can see performance is very good the motor is quite refined as well and i absolutely love the riding position on this one it is really very good and fun as well now it's not upright like the interceptor 650 and the seat is also harder when compared to the interceptor 650 whose seat is a tad too soft for my liking now through the corners it does inspire more confidence and because of the leaned inin position, there is more front-end feel on this motorcycle. So, among these two, I surely like this machine more. I mean, I didn't know I can flick through traffic with so much ease. And it is absolutely bombastic engine. 648 cc displacement, parallel twin, produces 47 PS of power and 53 Nm of torque. Really a very nice motor. The thing which really stands out here is the refinement. as well so then i feel like what is happening why is there no sound from this motor it lacks the thumb it is very smooth very refined has good amount of low end punch and this six-speed gearbox is so smooth shifting as well big leaps and bounds at royal enfield big leaps and bounds and trust me this motorcycle is going to bring new people to the brand because this one just feels so brilliant in every possible way it is so easy to ride it is so position here and here we go here we are oh that is so easy what is happening passage and here we go in first gear revving the motor and off we are 65 in first now in second and there goes the interceptor yeah obviously it is slightly lighter the interceptor in comparison the brakes work really well dual channel abs good bite at the levers the only thing is at higher speeds the and this is called the crawling mode you keep crawling and there you go and here we are i can do this all day from one cafe to another that's how brilliant this machine is it is so soothing to ride this motorcycle because it doesn't intimidate you for a 650 cc and definitely has good performance on offer as well it's smooth it's refined it's a good thing because now we'll get more motorcycles from other manufacturers and Competition is always a good thing which means we are going to get more affordable twin cylinder motorcycles twin cylinder is something which has been Kept away from us for long So guys before deciding between interceptor and GT 650 You definitely should write both of them because honestly the GT 650 is also a fab motorcycle Riding posture isn't as uncomfortable as I thought and that thinking comes from the old GT of course. Now the mileage you're gonna get from this motorcycle is between 20 to 25 kilometers per liter. Top speed is 170 kilometers per hour and it could have had a more bassy sound note which will obviously attract the purists, the Royal Enfield purists. As I see it this motorcycle is not going to attract many Royal Enfield purists because it lacks a thump, it lacks around 793 mm and it just feels so comfortable it's not a corner cover but definitely it feels so much inspiring around corners in the sense that you can actually push it decently well at higher speed through sweepers but don't expect it to remain glued to the road at higher speeds because the rear suspension it doesn't inspire so much confidence to maintain higher speeds and when i talk about higher speeds i'm talking 150 kilometers per hour slower than the KTM Duke 390 but you can't compare this with the Duke 390 the Duke 390 definitely heats a lot more has much more vibrations on offer this is just smooth smooth and smooth this is a motorcycle which is plain in terms of hardware bits and it's retro cool but the highlight here is the twin cylinder engine this engine really makes this motorcycle what it is what an engine what a motorcycle definitely i love it to the core and one more important thing i need to tell you about the pricing this one costs 17 000 more than that one the interceptor 650 and what you get is a better riding posture according to me yes it is less practical than the interceptor but i honestly feel it's a great motorcycle and definitely the one which all of us should consider if you're looking to buy either of these 650 twins so this particular motorcycle is the chrome edition it costs slightly more this one costs close to 3.6 lakhs all the prices are on road mumbai now there's a lot of variation in terms of pricing depending on if you want to take zero debt insurance and there's a lot to play with insurance itself because of the five-year insurance plan now but on these mumbai roads the ride quality is so comfortable it soaks everything in its stride and the handling is also great for this kind of a motorcycle like i told you this is not a track motorcycle this is not a knee-down motorcycle this is more about reaching a destination fast with a big smile on your face without putting too much effort in riding and in that sense oil enfield is doing a great job of making motorcycles which are easy and appeals to a larger segment of the audience so guys if you like this video make sure to give it the thumbs up, that's a like button and also subscribe to the channel. I will see you guys in the next video real soon. Bye.
